prose: Samaya AI reports that frontier models running in its finance-specific harness predicted earnings surprises better than expert analysts, which it calls a critical inflection point. The harness gives models point-in-time financial information on par with human experts.
The post presents a chart where recent models have lower revenue prediction error than analysts. This is a vendor's own research, selling the harness, so independent replication is not shown.
highlights: Frontier models beat expert analysts on earnings surprise prediction
Uses Samaya's finance harness with point-in-time data
